## Description

Video visit (ACS video) with identity check of the patient, camera/mic/recording toggles, consent for recording, ambient notes through the P3 pipeline, portal join flow.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Identity check is completed and recorded before consultation starts.
- [ ] **AC2.** Recording requires its own consent; declined → manual note.
- [ ] **AC3.** Telemedicine guideline requirements per country are documented and met.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
